{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Sigrika |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Hey, are you free next weekend? Want to come with me to {{Extra Effect|Bjartr Woods|Bjartr Woods|The forest where the Soliskin dwell. Bathed in the light of the Reactor Drive, the woods remain untouched by the ravages of Void Storms.}}? I know a secret spot there with lots of Dusk Honeypots! |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = These {{Extra Effect|Soliskin|Soliskin|A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.}} are my friends. I know one day they'll eventually return to the Solistrees, turning into tiny sparks. It's sad when friends leave, of course. But they told me that this is their choice. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = I've been studying these runes since I was very little. To me, they're never flat in my palm. They have depth. A piece of history, or a coordinate... like the grooves etched into Ashen Ironwood to mark the past. When I decipher them, I see projections of civilizations not yet known. What I see feels so vast that it makes me wonder. When I'm deciphering them... are they, in their own way, deciphering me? |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = After what happened, I called Mother and told her everything. About the riddles we solved together, how I'd been scared I wasn't good enough, and the times I almost gave up. And how every time, you were there to comfort me, telling me it was okay, even if I failed. Maybe that's how I managed to overcome the version of me in the Dark Side. Mother... She went quiet for a long time. When I asked if she was alright, she finally said, "You've been carrying so much all this time." I... I never thought she'd say that. But then I closed my eyes and thought: That feels really, really good. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Now, I want to learn more interesting things and see places I've never been. I won't run away from what everyone hopes for me, but I also want to listen to my own heart a little more. To try things that only I can experience. You've told me about so many amazing places, like {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}, {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}}, Septimont... If I ever get the chance, I'd really love to visit them! And when that day comes, would you come with me? |vo_02_01_title = Sigrika's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Back home, a hug means something special. When someone leaves, we send them off with a hug full of blessings. And when they return, we welcome them with a hug full of joy. The frostlands are so cold that it feels like the air itself might freeze. In a world like that, what you need most is the kind of warmth that's light as feathers. So... would you like a hug, Senior? |vo_02_02_title = Sigrika's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Every time I leave home for school, Mother packs a huge jar of Fruit Crackle for me. She makes it all herself, and it's always so sweet. She wraps the jar carefully in ice so it stays crisp until I open it. That's why the jar always feels so heavy when I carry it… It's heavy with a warmth too big to hold. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Have you ever tried Grilled Fern Spore? Don't, seriously don't! It's so bitter just thinking about it makes me grind my teeth... If I ever had to eat something that awful, I'd rather eat at the cafeteria! Not that we actually call the cafeteria food "food," right? ...Wait, you're saying the cafeteria's serving Grilled Fern Spore Jelly tomorrow? Oh no, no, no, no! Grilled Fern Spore is already a nightmare, and jelly made from it? I... |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I still want to live up to everyone's expectations! But now, I won't push myself too hard, and I won't stop just because I'm afraid of failing. Because now I know... this is the path I chose. And I want to give it everything I have! |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This hair accessory? It was a gift from Father. He's always trekking across the frostlands, bringing home all sorts of strange trinkets. He used to tell me that our lives shouldn't end within {{Extra Effect|Bjartr Woods}}. Well, someday, when I get the chance, I want to travel around too. Then maybe... I can bring back some interesting stories of my own, bright enough to make the little ones in the tribe smile. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = When I was little, Mother would take me out to the frostlands to herd the {{Extra Effect|Exoswarm|Exoswarm|Biomechanical creatures formed from the Exostrider's cellular remnants. By mimicking herds and other lifeforms, they helped rebuild Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.}}. At night, I'd lie on their backs and look up at the stars, one by one. Mother said stars are the endpoint of a riddle. She would connect them, one to another. And just like that… everything looked different! The stars were no longer scattered pieces of gold. Each one held its own meaning. That was my first understanding of "riddles." What is a riddle? What is the solving? What is the answer? The riddle is the {{Rubi|starry sky|Rune}} itself. The solving is finding the hidden connections within it. And the {{Rubi|answer|True Name}}… is in the very moment you see those connections come together. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Denia]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Denia.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Nia always says, "If you can't finish it, just drop it. Toss away whatever's hard or sad. Running away makes everything so much easier." But whenever I'm up late studying, she's always right there beside me. Sometimes I think… maybe she's actually the one who least wants to run away. She never talks about herself, so I can't quite see what's going on in her heart. Still... I hope we can stay friends for a very, very long time. |vo_04_01_mention = Denia |vo_04_02_title = About [[Lynae]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Lynae.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer. |vo_04_02_mention = Lynae |vo_04_03_title = About [[Aemeath]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Aemeath.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = I really, really love Fleet Snowfluff's songs! But the last time she held a fan meeting, I was out on a frostlands field study... I-I hope I'll get another chance to attend! I would love to see her! |vo_04_03_mention = Aemeath |vo_04_04_title = About [[Luuk Herssen]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Luuk Herssen.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = After the New Solar Celebration incident, some students said we should make a banner for Dr. Luuk. It seems that whenever someone's feeling down, he's always there, checking on them, talking with them for as long as they need. They suggested things like "{{Extra Effect|Startorch|Startorch Academy|Startorch Academy is a comprehensive research facility that doesn't belong to any country, built with the goal of collaborative scientific research. It is an academic metroplis driven solely by educational and research pursuits. Compared to its official title of "Startorch Academy," the people of Solaris prefer to call it the "Resonator Academy."}}'s Best Counselor" or "Best Doctor and Best Advisor." But if you ask me… I think I'd just write, "The One Who Always Has Candy." |vo_04_04_mention = Luuk Herssen |vo_04_05_title = About [[Lucilla]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Lucilla.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = President Lucilla's classes are so much fun. When she taught the history of Royan clothing, she even turned it into an impromptu styling workshop! But getting into her classes is almost impossible. Every time the course listings go up, I have to glue myself to the screen and click as fast as I can, or they'll be gone in seconds! And on the professor review forum, her page is just full of students complaining, "How can someone who teaches everything have classes that fill up in seconds?!" |vo_04_05_mention = Lucilla |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Today's your birthday, right? Happy birthday, my dearest Senior! This whole box of gifts is for you! Look! A jar of Fruit Crackle, a scarf woven with rune blessings, and a fluffy Soliskin plushie… and this Sunstone I made. No matter where you are, it'll always point you toward the sun. I hope sunlight always follows you, and that every wish you make comes true! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Smile for the camera... Three, two, one... |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Effort Sound) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hello. Mother—Mm, I'm doing well. Made a few new friends...
How are you doing? ...Yes, I know. Just promise me you're looking after yourself.
I really want to eat the Fruit Crackle you make...
My grades? Oh, not bad! Come on, don't worry about me! Yes, yes, I will. I promise... |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Hi, I'm Sigrika! Want to understand the meaning of runes? Need a hand with something? Then I'm the one to ask! |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = I'll keep all of this in my heart forever. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Precious like gold... |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = I will find a solution. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = The runes will be our guide. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Now, time to mark the next starting point... |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = I can see more now... So ''that's'' what was troubling me all along. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = From something flat to something with great depth, the meaning of the runes unfolds before my eyes. It feels infinite... |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Sigrika |language = en |basic_1_tx = Leg cannon! |heavy_1_tx = Hyah! |heavy_2_tx = This is it! |heavy_3_tx = Found you! |heavy_4_tx = Be my aid! |heavy_5_tx = Chuluu! |heavy_6_tx = Slide. |aerial_1_tx = Guluuluu— |aerial_2_tx = Gently... |aerial_3_tx = Hey! |aerial_4_tx = ...Down you go! |resskill_1_tx = The wind's True Name. |resskill_2_tx = Feel the breath. |resskill_3_tx = Uh-oh, careful— |resskill_4_tx = One, two, three... |resskill_5_tx = Know what "explosion" means? |resskill_6_tx = Boom! |resskill_7_tx = Detonate! |resskill_8_tx = You're gonna remember this! |resskill_9_tx = Cool your head! |resliberation_1_tx = True Name, illuminate! |resliberation_2_tx = Straight to the stars. |resliberation_3_tx = (Effort Sounds) |introoutro_1_tx = Let me. |hit_1_tx = Ouch! That hurts! |hit_2_tx = I flew! |hit_3_tx = I should be more careful. |injured_1_tx = Just a tiny slip. |injured_2_tx = Can I keep going like this? |injured_3_tx = This doesn't define me. |fallen_1_tx = Couldn't live up to... those expectations... |fallen_2_tx = Even stars fall sometimes... |fallen_3_tx = Was it... my fault? |esummon_1_tx = Greet my friends. |etransform_1_tx = {{Extra Effect|Soliskin}} Sigrika! |enemynear_1_tx = Leave this riddle to me. |glider_1_tx = Just like a bird... |sensor_1_tx = The answer is nearby. |dash_1_tx = Faster than a rabbit. |chest_1_tx = Shining like a star! |chest_2_tx = A reward for solving a riddle. |chest_3_tx = I'll keep it safe. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.2}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
